references.text: Jesus emphasizes that love for him must come before love for family, which is similar to his question about who his mother and brothers are in Matthew 12:48.
David feels abandoned by those closest to him, reflecting Jesus' message of spiritual family over biological family.
Jesus speaks to his mother at the cross, showing his care for her even as he redefines family relationships.
Paul describes the church as a family, which resonates with Jesus' definition of his spiritual family.
Jesus is not ashamed to call us brothers, emphasizing the idea of a spiritual family.
